extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvalue
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Scalar λ satisfying Ax = λx and found from det(A - λI) = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Nonzero vector x satisfying Ax = λx for some eigenvalue λ.

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvalue equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The equation Ax = λx defining eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix A
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The square matrix whose eigenvalues and eigenvectors are studied.

extracted_concepts.name: Identity matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix I used in A - λI when finding eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Characteristic equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The equation det(A - λI) = 0 whose roots are eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Determinant
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Scalar function det used in det(A - λI) = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Null space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solution space of (A - λI)x = 0 containing eigenvectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Diagonalization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Factorization A = SΛS⁻¹ using eigenvectors and eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Diagonalizable matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A matrix that can be written as A = SΛS⁻¹.

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvector matrix S
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix S whose columns are eigenvectors of A.

extracted_concepts.name: Diagonal matrix Λ
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Diagonal matrix Λ containing eigenvalues of A.

extracted_concepts.name: Inverse matrix S⁻¹
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Inverse of the eigenvector matrix S in A = SΛS⁻¹.

extracted_concepts.name: Linearly independent eigenvectors
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A set of n eigenvectors needed for diagonalization of an n×n matrix.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix power Aⁿ
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Power Aⁿ computed as SΛⁿS⁻¹ when A is diagonalizable.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear differential equation dx/dt = Ax
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differential equation solved using eigenvalues and eigenvectors of A.

extracted_concepts.name: Markov chain
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Stochastic process listed as an eigenvalue application.

extracted_concepts.name: PageRank
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Google ranking method related to Markov chains and eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Principal Component Analysis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Data-analysis method listed as an eigenvalue application.

extracted_concepts.name: Symmetric matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Real matrix equal to its transpose, with special eigen properties.

extracted_concepts.name: Real eigenvalues
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Eigenvalues that are real numbers, guaranteed for real symmetric matrices.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthogonal eigenvectors
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Eigenvectors that are mutually orthogonal for real symmetric matrices.

extracted_concepts.name: Spectral Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The theorem stating A = QΛQᵀ for symmetric matrices with orthogonal Q.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthogonal matrix Q
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix Q with orthonormal eigenvectors, satisfying Qᵀ = Q⁻¹.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear transformation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Transformation whose essential scaling directions are revealed by eigenvalues.
